objective: Declare the measurement basis of every outcome-bearing row on both outcome ledgers (trades.csv, labels.csv) so a spine number and a labeler number stop being silently treated as comparable when they were produced under different rulers. New module src/governance/measurement_basis.py defines two NEW closed axes (tie_break, reference_level) plus re-exports the THREE existing axes from identity.tokens (walk_kernel, cost_model_id, fill_model_id) rather than re-declaring them. Alias tables canonicalise 5 unreconciled spellings of the same component cost model onto ONE member -- canonicalise() never guesses; an unrecognised spelling becomes UNSTAMPED. can_compare(a, b) is STRICTER than identity.tokens.L5_BASIS equality: it also refuses on tie_break and reference_level mismatch, which L5 equality alone cannot see (L5_BASIS itself deliberately left unextended per tokens.py's own 'do not change L5 equality' comment). Both ledgers gain the axes they were missing: labels.csv gains cost_model_id/walk_kernel/fill_model_id/reference_level (it already had sl_geom/tie_break); trades.csv gains walk_kernel/reference_level/fill_model_id/tie_break/sl_refloored (it already had cost_model_id/cost_model_params_hash/risk_denominator_id from CH-cost-model-identity-stamp). New public CRTEngine.intrabar_exits property lets the spine's tie_break be read from what the engine actually resolved, never re-derived from config alone (the TRUST_INTRABAR_TOUCH env override can disagree). provenance.truth_standard_block's tie_break parameter is now REQUIRED (was hardcoded 'SL_before_TP' with no parameter); ~21 call sites across src/research/ and scripts/research/ updated in the same commit to pass TIE_BREAK_PRODUCTION, verified correct for every current caller since all measure via forward_walk's hardcoded SL-first convention. New invariant I9 (verify_basis_declaration) in identity_chain.py checks every outcome-bearing row carries all five axes as closed-vocabulary members (free text FAILs) and that can_compare over every pair of distinct bases present returns a named verdict, never crashes -- unlike I8, a file may legitimately hold several distinct bases (labels.csv carries 4 arms), so I9 does not require one basis per file. One new ontology node SEM-038 MEASUREMENT_BASIS_DECLARATION; SEM-015/SEM-017/SEM-018 refined in place (version bump, no duplicate) to name the enum members their mathematical_definition already referenced abstractly. Declaration only: no trading decision, no PnL, no cost arithmetic, no risk_distance, no label VALUE, no CANONICAL_FEATURES/SCHEMA_HASH, no config key, no ACTIVE_VERSION changes -- proved by byte-identity tests on both ledgers, not merely asserted. This closes the DECLARE half of the originating thread's E1-E3 parity contracts; the UNIFY half (making the rulers agree, not merely naming them) is separate, deferred, breaking work tracked in the follow-up backlog.
